newsitem.title: USA: Video Update in talks for possible Moovies deal.
newsitem.headline: Video Update in talks for possible Moovies deal.

text.p: Video Update Inc, a video rental chain, said Wednesday it is in preliminary discussions regarding the potential acquisition of Moovies Inc.

In a statement, Video Update said the discussions are preliminary in nature and no definitive terms or agreements have been reached. No assurances can be made that a transaction will be completed, it added.
Video Update said it does not intend to make any further statements regarding the preliminary discussions unless there are material developments that warrant disclosure.
Earlier this month, Video Update completed its acquisition of Superior Video, a 27-store video rental chain in British Columbia.
Video Update has 381 superstores in North America, of which 31 are franchised.
In May , Moovies said it would reduce the number of new stores to be opened this year to about 50 from 80. At that time, Moovie operated 262 video specialty stores in 17 states.
